en.summary: CoinW offers people new to the exchange a 100 USDT Super Bonus for completing qualifying tasks, announced alongside the launch of ANT/USDT perpetual futures. One person can get 100 USDT, but the announcement does not name the tasks or the dates.
steps: Make sure the offer is for you: it is aimed at people new to CoinW. The announcement does not define exactly who counts as new.
Find the list of qualifying tasks: the announcement does not include it and points to Learn More for details.
Complete the qualifying tasks. Their amounts, products and deadline are not stated in the announcement.

payout.when: The announcement does not say when the bonus is credited or whether there is a claim deadline. The start and end dates of the promo are not stated either.
payout.form: A 100 USDT Super Bonus. The announcement does not say whether it can be withdrawn or only used for trading. Check the bonus terms on CoinW before counting on cash.
payout.how: The announcement does not say where the bonus appears or whether you must claim it manually.

watch: The tasks, timing and eligibility requirements are not disclosed. Do not deposit or trade for the bonus until you have read the full terms.
The bonus is aimed at new users. The announcement promises nothing to people who already have an account.
Leverage of up to 75x means trading an amount up to 75 times your margin (the money you put up). Even a small price move against you can wipe out that margin quickly.
The announcement is about perpetual futures, which are contracts on a price with no expiry date. It says nothing about owning shares of ANTHROPIC.
Limits on places, a total pool, regional restrictions, KYC and trading fees are not described in the text.

faq.q: Do I have to trade ANT/USDT to get the bonus?
faq.a: It is not stated directly. The announcement mentions ANT/USDT trading and, separately, qualifying tasks for new users, but it does not list the tasks.

faq.q: Do I have to use 75x leverage?
faq.a: The announcement only says leverage goes up to 75x. It does not require you to trade at the maximum.
The announcement promises a 100 USDT Super Bonus for completing the qualifying tasks. It does not say whether there is a quota or other limits, so check the full terms.
The announcement does not let you tell: it has no start or end date. Check on CoinW whether it is still running.
The announcement gives no deposit amount and does not say whether a deposit is needed at all.
